title: WPSS/2828/2017 of Malkhan Singh Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND OTHERS

paras.text:
WPSS No. 2828 of 2017
Hon'ble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.
Ms. Menkaa Tripathi, Advocate for the
petitioner.
Ms. Mamta Bisht, Deputy Advocate General
for the State of Uttarakhand.
Mr. Vinay Kumar, Advocate for respondent
nos. 5 to 10.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.
Petitioner alongwith one Mr. Subhash Chandra
was appointed as Assistant Accountant in Treasury
Department pursuant to the same selection held in
the year 1999. Date of joining of the petitioner on the
said post is 09.03.1999; while, that of Mr. Subhash
Chandra is 26.2.1999, however, petitioner was
treated to be senior in the cadre of Assistant
Accountants by virtue of his merit.
Pursuant to a policy decision taken by the
State Government, designation and pay scale of
Accountant was to be given to Assistant Accountants
in the ratio of 80:20. In terms of the policy decision,
Subhash Chandra was granted pay scale and
designation of Accountant w.e.f. 08.08.2002; while,
petitioner was denied the said benefit.
Petitioner made a representation to the District
Magistrate, Udham Singh Nagar and when no
decision was taken thereupon, he filed WPSS No.
815 of 2017, which was disposed of by this Court
with a direction to the competent authority to take
decision on his representation.
In terms of the order of this Court, petitioner's
representation was allowed by the District
Magistrate, Udham Singh Nagar vide order dated
22.06.2017 and petitioner was given the designation
of Accountant notionally w.e.f. 08.08.2002, however,
arrears of pay were not paid to him.
Petitioner is aggrieved by the fact that, in the
seniority list of Accountants maintained at the State
level, issued on 16.07.2015, his seniority has not
been refixed. According to learned counsel for the
petitioner, since petitioner was notionally promoted
to the post of Accountant w.e.f. 08.08.2002,

therefore, the date of his notional promotion to the
post of Accountant needs to be mentioned in the
State-wise seniority list and accordingly his seniority
is required to be re-fixed.
This Court finds substance in the submission
made by learned counsel for the petitioner. When
petitioner was notionally promoted as Accountant by
the District Magistrate, Udham Singh Nagar vide
order dated 27.06.2017, then this fact needs to be
mentioned in the State-wise seniority list of
Accountants issued on 16.07.2015.
Accordingly, the writ petition is disposed of
with a direction to the Director, Treasury and
Pension, Uttarakhand to look into the matter and
make necessary correction in the seniority list of
Accountants within six weeks from the date of
production of certified copy of this order.
Interim order shall continue to operate for a
period of six weeks or till the seniority is revised,
whichever is earlier.
Since this Court has not dealt with petitioner's
claim regarding arrears of salary for the post of
Accountant on account of his notional promotion,
therefore, he shall be at liberty to approach the
appropriate forum for the said relief, in accordance
with law.
All pending application stand disposed of.
 (Manoj K. Tiwari, J.)
Navin 17.07.2019
